title: Script Progress: run_history.json
description: One row per finished run, appended by complete(). The reporter keeps the last 100 rows, oldest first.

task.description: Task name, exactly as passed to Progress(). Process Calendar entries match against the start of this string.

date.description: ISO timestamp of when the run finished. Sorting, the calendar and the daily summary all read this.

success.description: true when the run completed successfully, false when it failed or crashed.

elapsed.description: How long the run took, in seconds. Feeds the duration trend sparkline and the ETA of the next run.

summary.description: One-line result written by the script, e.g. 'INSERT: 3,990 rows'. An unhandled exception becomes 'Unhandled error: ...'.

warnings.description: How many warnings the run raised. Shown in the table; the text of each is in warningItems.

runId.description: Optional (v1.1). Unique id for this run, matching the runId in progress.json.

startedAt.description: Optional (v1.1). ISO timestamp of when the run started.

metrics.description: Optional (v1.1). Metrics reported during the run. Shown in the expanded detail row and exported to CSV.

additionalProperties.description: Metric value: a number, or a short string.

warningItems.description: Optional (v1.1). The warning text itself (the reporter keeps the last 20), so history rows can be expanded without the original run being live.

accessed.description: Optional (v1.1). Access Map node ids this run touched, in the order they were first touched.

items.description: Access Map node id, in the form '<type>:<name>', e.g. 'file:input/orders.csv'.

artifacts.description: Optional (v1.1). Files this run produced, shown as clickable links in the expanded detail row.

items.description: Path to a file the run produced, absolute or relative to the workspace folder.

warning.description: One warning raised during the run.

time.description: ISO timestamp of when the warning was raised.
